== Summary ==
Slip “•Tatooine: Desert Heart” cut unchanged from page 5 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (68, 75, 581, 798)). Version [[Tatooine: Desert Heart (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
